description: One commune by INSEE code (Paris, Lyon and Marseille arrondissements map to their commune). By default, its accounts per inhabitant for one year against the median of communes of the same size. Sections: history (yearly accounts since 2018), functions (spending by service), local (local tax rates, income tax, electoral turnout, DGF), buyer (public contracts as buyer), representatives (deputies and senators). `year` selects the accounts year; the latest by default.

insee.description: INSEE commune code, 5 characters, e.g. 69123 or 2A004

section.description: Part to return. Without it, the headline figures and the list of sections.
